character: Wolf Heimlich and Olympia Myklos in Carrington's office
voice: Mutually flirtatious and morbid, with Wolf's menace grounded in possessive authority rather than national caricature.

entries.text: Oh, Wolfie, I'm so glad you agreed to meet me here.
You know I cannot resist you, Olympia.
Oh, Wolf, you're so strong. Lift me onto the desk, will you?
Anything you ask, my dear. I would lie, steal, even kill for you.
Wolfie, you give me the chills. Please, frighten me some more.
Very well, if it pleases you.
More than anything. Who else will die tonight?
The Countess. She prowls these galleries as though she owns them and ignores every rule I set. One day, her carelessness will be the death of her.
The Countess? Do you think she is in danger? Didn't she go home after the party?
Someone admits her after hours. If I catch her trespassing again, there will be consequences.
Perhaps I'll be lucky this time. Perhaps I could discover her body!
That's one of the things I love about you, Wolfie. You have a wonderful sense of humor.
Thank you. Yours is equally... distinctive.
